plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, raises the idea that Edward Condon, a physicist who led a government-backed study that came out against UFOs, was blackmailed into doing so. Michels says that while Condon was being investigated in the 1950s for supposed communist sympathies, an agent of the FBI, the US federal police, named Guy Hottel was quietly building a file of reports on him. If true, it would mean the official dismissal of UFOs was pushed along by pressure on the man in charge.
